title: Robo-Derby: The Great Harbor Clash
idea: When a celebrated crimson-and-black harbor football club faces a monumental autumn showdown, The Boss threatens to pull the plug on their touring carnival unless the crew correctly forecasts the match. Prof meticulously calculates maritime wind trajectories, Tank examines overlooked reserve squad data, and Slim proudly guarantees an effortless victory. Lucky flips his coin, banking on chaotic rainy-day rebounds. But when a surprise seaside gale scrambles the stadium turf into a slick obstacle course, their rivalry boils over as they frantically adapt.
visual: A futuristic bayfront soccer coliseum glows under deep crimson and gold floodlights amid swirling coastal autumn mist. The five colorful robots huddle intently along a rain-slicked sideline railing, their silhouettes set against bustling mechanical crowds and the hyper-kinetic action on the pristine green pitch below.
